neighbours.label: The token ' the' right after a preposition (in the, on the, between the, with the); ' the' after a verb or conjunction fires only weakly, and a preposition followed by 'a' does not fire
fire: Two herons stood in the shallow water near a bridge.
A cat slept on the warm stones behind our house.
Thick fog hung over the valley until noon.
Someone left a red umbrella under the stairs last night.
My sister walked with the children along a muddy path.
A narrow road runs between the two farms for a mile.
Fresh snow lay across the fields beyond our gate.
A lantern swung from the mast as waves rose.
quiet: Two herons stood in shallow water near a bridge.
A cat slept on warm stones behind our house.
Thick fog hid the valley until noon.
Someone found the red umbrella and kept it overnight.
My sister walked with her children along a muddy path.
A narrow road joins the two farms after a mile.
Fresh snow lay across a field beyond our gate.
A lantern lit the mast as waves rose.

notes: Card: all 32 top peaks are ' the', after a preposition (between, in, on, with), at a tiny scale (max 0.50); it flags the pole broad (4.1% of tokens reach 0.1 of max) and gate-closed ('-x- echo' 76%). Probes: in the 0.85, on the 0.74, between the 0.65; verb + the 0.16-0.19; 'in a cellar' 0.02; no 'the' 0.01. Layer 1, so tested as a token-in-context, not a meaning.
